title: Hornig guards the Trinity bomb the night before the test

tellings.quote: And on the night before the first test at Trinity, Oenheimer gave him a weapon and made him guard the bomb in the tower during a storm.

plain: On the night before Trinity, the first atomic bomb test in New Mexico in 1945, the physicist J. Robert Oppenheimer, who led the bomb project, is said to have handed a weapon to a young scientist named Donald Hornig and told him to guard the bomb in its tower through a storm. A former NASA scientist named Kevin Knuth tells it from what Hornig himself told him. It is told as a firsthand link to the start of the nuclear age.
